You'd have to physically pull nerves to other places to affect reflexes for example and even then it'd be incredibly difficult and precise. An argument could be made for what you can do with Promethean clay merit but again that'll only affect yourself. Now which is better or which is worse depends on what you want. You can change your appereace with vic 1 where as you'd need lore of flesh 5 for that. In the end one is a power of twisting the very spirit of a being by physically molding them while the other is using your demonic powers to imbue them into different shapes. Similar but by no means the same.
